title: Easy cooking at its best
text: Easy cooking at its best. You know when you’re trying to season meet and you have meat juice all over your hands and you can’t touch anything so as long as you have one hand all you have to do is tilted up, and get fresh ground salt and pepper, it’s great I can’t recommend them enough. I think I’ll be buying some as gifts for Christmas!

product_metadata.title: Electric Gravity Salt and Pepper Grinder Set Tesedao Salt Pepper Mill Electric Spices Manual Spice Adjustable Coarseness One-handed Operation Suitable for Grinding Pepper, Himalayan Salt, Spices
features: BATTERY-POWERED: Each grinder requires 6 AAA batteries (batteries not included), you don't have to spend a lot of manual grinding, you don't even need to press any buttons, just flip the electric grinder and you can easily get fresh seasonings
HIGH-QUALITY WORKMANSHIP: High quality stainless steel cap provides a comfortable feel for the grinder, and the transparent vitreous allows you to see the remaining fragrance in the grinder.
AUTO LED: When flipping the electric pepper grinder, there will be a blue automatic led light, you can easily see the amount of salt and pepper you put in the food.
ADJUSTABLE: The electric pepper grinder uses a high-quality ceramic rotor, so you can easily adjust the grinder knob to select the roughness of the spice.
